fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Zielinski and I live at 953 Willow Court, Dover, DE 19955. You can reach me on (555) 908-4479 or dmitri.zielinski@example.com. On 9 April 2025 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Imogen Ferreira, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2024-00081. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Zielinski on (555) 908-4479 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 9 April 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Declan Santos gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Imogen Ferreira reports a mild concussion and attended County General. Dmitri reports lacerations to the forearm.
